items.prompt: What should an observed test record contain?
options: Expected and actual outcome for a defined flow
items.explanation: Comparable observations allow the policy to be audited.

items.prompt: Which syslog severity is more urgent: 2 or 6?
options: 2, because lower severity numbers are more urgent
items.explanation: Severity 2 is critical; 6 is informational. The urgency scale runs from 0 emergency to 7 debugging.

items.prompt: The active gateway loses its upstream path but its LAN interface remains up. What design consideration matters?
options: Tracking relevant upstream health to influence gateway role
items.explanation: LAN-side liveness alone may not reflect remote reachability. Appropriate tracking can help align the active role with a usable path.

items.prompt: An API returns HTTP 202 for a network change. Which conclusion is justified?
options: The request was accepted for processing; completion still needs checking
The change is verified on every device
items.explanation: 202 indicates acceptance, not necessarily completed processing or validated network behavior.

items.prompt: After a first-hop redundancy failover, which client setting is intended to remain stable?
options: The DHCP server’s disk serial number
items.explanation: The redundant routers coordinate the virtual gateway so clients need not reconfigure their gateway for the role change.

items.prompt: Give the number of usable host addresses for 172.16.250.59/29. Enter digits only.
items.explanation: 172.16.250.59/29 belongs to 172.16.250.56/29; broadcast 172.16.250.63; 6 ordinary usable host addresses.

items.prompt: An edge port with BPDU guard receives a BPDU. Which result is consistent with the protection?
options: The port can be disabled by the guard
The port becomes the root bridge
The BPDU is converted to DNS
items.explanation: BPDU guard protects appropriate edge assumptions by reacting to unexpected BPDUs; exact recovery depends on platform configuration.

items.prompt: Two tenants reuse the same subnet but require independent routing tables on one device. Which mechanism fits?
items.explanation: A VRF creates a separate routing/forwarding context. Any communication between contexts needs an intentional design.

items.prompt: On a broadcast segment, two DROTHER neighbors are 2-WAY with each other. What is the best interpretation?
options: This can be normal; inspect their DR/BDR adjacencies
All 2-WAY states prove a broken link
items.explanation: Not all pairs on a broadcast network form FULL adjacencies. DROTHER routers form full adjacencies with the DR/BDR.

items.prompt: In {"enabled":true,"vlan":10}, what type is enabled?
items.explanation: Unquoted true is a JSON boolean. "true" would be a string and would not be the same value/type.

items.prompt: An unknown unicast arrives in VLAN 20. Where is it flooded?
items.explanation: Flooding remains inside the VLAN and obeys forwarding state.

items.prompt: Which /28 network is aligned?
items.explanation: /28 blocks start at multiples of 16.

items.prompt: Give the network address for 172.27.168.40/28. Enter a dotted IPv4 address.
items.explanation: 172.27.168.40/28 belongs to 172.27.168.32/28; broadcast 172.27.168.47; 14 ordinary usable host addresses.

items.prompt: Must every AP connect to a trunk port in every wireless architecture?
options: No AP ever uses a wired uplink
No; access/trunk needs depend on traffic-switching design
items.explanation: Central versus local traffic switching and VLAN design affect the required AP uplink configuration.

items.prompt: An installed /24 OSPF route and /16 static route both match. Which normally forwards the packet?
options: The /24 because forwarding uses longest prefix match
items.explanation: Administrative distance compares candidate sources for the same prefix; installed forwarding uses the longest match.

items.prompt: How should overlap be checked?
items.explanation: Two reservations may overlap even when their gateways differ.

items.prompt: Where should a narrow permit exception appear relative to its broad deny?
items.explanation: The exception must match before the broader deny.

items.prompt: A client opens TCP from port 51000 to a server on 443. Which port pair normally appears in the server response?
items.explanation: The response reverses the transport endpoints. Ports identify transport conversations rather than physical switch ports.

items.prompt: A remote service fails but the primary static route remains installed. Why might a floating route not activate?
options: Its preference is not an end-to-end service health probe
Floating routes only support public addresses
The backup must always have a lower distance
items.explanation: A higher-distance backup waits for the preferred route to stop winning. Detecting remote failure can require additional mechanisms.

items.prompt: Installed routes: 10.0.0.0/8 via 192.0.2.64 (AD 1); 10.106.5.176/28 via 192.0.2.99 (AD 110); default via 192.0.2.190. Which next-hop IPv4 address is eligible for 10.106.6.189? Enter only the next-hop address.
items.explanation: The destination does not match the subnet route. The matching /8 wins over the default route.

items.prompt: Which check helps verify a working EtherChannel?
items.explanation: The logical bundle must form with compatible members.

items.prompt: An ACL has these entries in order: 10 deny ip 192.168.101.0 0.0.0.255 any; 20 permit ip host 192.168.101.6 any; 30 permit ip any any. What happens to a packet sourced by 192.168.101.6? Enter permit or deny.
items.explanation: ACLs stop at the first matching entry. Here the subnet deny matches first.

items.prompt: Which exercise adds evidence beyond following a reference configuration once?
options: Rebuilding independently and explaining controlled failures
items.explanation: Independent reconstruction and diagnosis test understanding that a copied configuration alone cannot demonstrate.

items.prompt: A redundant port is blocking under spanning tree. What comes first?
options: Inspect topology, root and port roles
items.explanation: Blocking can be intentional loop prevention.

items.prompt: A broad subnet deny precedes a permit for one host inside that subnet. What happens to that host’s matching traffic?
items.explanation: ACL processing stops at the first matching entry. A later exception cannot override an earlier broad match.

items.prompt: AI generates a plausible but unsupported command. What is the right next step?
options: Apply it to every device to compare failures
Treat fluent wording as successful validation
Verify platform documentation and test in an isolated lab
items.explanation: Generated output needs platform/version checks and execution evidence before it can support a real change.

items.prompt: No ACL entry matches a packet. What is the usual result?
items.explanation: An implicit deny follows the explicit entries.

items.prompt: For DHCP snooping, which path is the intended trust candidate in a basic access design?
items.explanation: Trust follows the legitimate server direction. Trusting all client ports defeats the purpose of rejecting rogue server messages.

items.prompt: Give the broadcast address for 172.20.172.52/28. Enter a dotted IPv4 address.
items.explanation: 172.20.172.52/28 belongs to 172.20.172.48/28; broadcast 172.20.172.63; 14 ordinary usable host addresses.

items.prompt: Installed routes: 10.0.0.0/8 via 192.0.2.164 (AD 1); 10.93.5.96/28 via 192.0.2.107 (AD 110); default via 192.0.2.13. Which next-hop IPv4 address is eligible for 10.93.6.108? Enter only the next-hop address.
items.explanation: The destination does not match the subnet route. The matching /8 wins over the default route.

items.prompt: What exactly summarizes adjacent 10.20.0.0/26 and 10.20.0.64/26?
items.explanation: The combined interval is .0 through .127, an aligned /25.

items.prompt: A switch receives source MAC A and destination MAC B on Fa0/3. Which entry can it learn directly from this arrival?
options: A belongs on Fa0/3 in the receiving VLAN
items.explanation: Learning uses the source address and incoming port. The destination lookup is a separate forwarding step.

items.prompt: Give the broadcast address for 172.24.205.183/26. Enter a dotted IPv4 address.
items.explanation: 172.24.205.183/26 belongs to 172.24.205.128/26; broadcast 172.24.205.191; 62 ordinary usable host addresses.

items.prompt: Where should the helper for a remote DHCP server normally be applied?
options: The router interface receiving the client broadcasts
items.explanation: Relay begins on the client-facing interface so it can forward the original client broadcast toward the server.

items.prompt: How should overlap be checked?
items.explanation: Two reservations may overlap even when their gateways differ.

items.prompt: Give the network address for 172.31.63.158/26. Enter a dotted IPv4 address.
items.explanation: 172.31.63.158/26 belongs to 172.31.63.128/26; broadcast 172.31.63.191; 62 ordinary usable host addresses.

items.prompt: A host moves to another switch port. Why are dynamic learning and aging useful?
options: They assign a new IPv4 subnet
They let forwarding state adapt to changing attachments
items.explanation: Source learning can update the host location, and aging removes unused stale entries. Neither assigns IP addresses.

items.prompt: Which gateway is usable in 10.20.0.64/27?
items.explanation: The usable interval is .65 through .94.

items.prompt: Which statement correctly separates reliability from confidentiality?
options: A TCP handshake authenticates the human user
TCP retransmission does not itself encrypt application data
items.explanation: Transport reliability, encryption, and user authentication are different functions. Applications can add protection over either transport model.

items.prompt: Which reservation overlaps 10.20.0.0/26?
items.explanation: The /26 reserves .0 through .63.

items.prompt: Which is the network for 172.16.31.250/20?
items.explanation: /20 has third-octet increments of 16. Octet 31 belongs to the 16–31 block.

items.prompt: A client opens TCP from port 51000 to a server on 443. Which port pair normally appears in the server response?
items.explanation: The response reverses the transport endpoints. Ports identify transport conversations rather than physical switch ports.

items.prompt: Which /28 network is aligned?
items.explanation: /28 blocks start at multiples of 16.

items.prompt: An interface has 12 old CRC errors. Which next observation best distinguishes a current impairment from an old event?
options: Whether CRC errors increase during the test interval
items.explanation: Counter deltas show current behavior. A historical nonzero total alone does not establish an ongoing fault.

items.prompt: A client associates successfully but obtains no DHCP lease. What should be investigated next?
options: WLAN-to-VLAN mapping and the DHCP path
items.explanation: Association and IP configuration are separate stages. VLAN carriage, relay, and DHCP service can fail after association succeeds.

items.prompt: Which reservation should be allocated first in a simple VLSM plan?
items.explanation: Largest-first allocation reduces fragmentation.

items.prompt: Give the number of usable host addresses for 172.31.235.230/27. Enter digits only.
items.explanation: 172.31.235.230/27 belongs to 172.31.235.224/27; broadcast 172.31.235.255; 30 ordinary usable host addresses.

items.prompt: For 192.168.12.70/26, which is an ordinary valid on-link gateway candidate?
items.explanation: The network is .64/26, with usable .65–.126. .1 is outside the subnet and .127 is its broadcast address.

items.prompt: Give the number of usable host addresses for 172.21.29.180/27. Enter digits only.
items.explanation: 172.21.29.180/27 belongs to 172.21.29.160/27; broadcast 172.21.29.191; 30 ordinary usable host addresses.

items.prompt: Give the network address for 172.21.136.145/27. Enter a dotted IPv4 address.
items.explanation: 172.21.136.145/27 belongs to 172.21.136.128/27; broadcast 172.21.136.159; 30 ordinary usable host addresses.

items.prompt: Why specify an exit interface with an IPv6 link-local static next hop?
options: Link-local addresses are globally unique server names
The link identifies the scope of the next-hop address
items.explanation: A link-local address is meaningful on a particular link and can be reused on other links.

items.prompt: Give the broadcast address for 172.30.78.85/25. Enter a dotted IPv4 address.
items.explanation: 172.30.78.85/25 belongs to 172.30.78.0/25; broadcast 172.30.78.127; 126 ordinary usable host addresses.

items.prompt: What is the final conventional usable host in 10.8.7.144/28?
items.explanation: The block spans .144–.159. Network and broadcast consume its endpoints, leaving .145–.158 for conventional hosts.

items.prompt: Two tenants reuse the same subnet but require independent routing tables on one device. Which mechanism fits?
items.explanation: A VRF creates a separate routing/forwarding context. Any communication between contexts needs an intentional design.
